The Writ Petition has been filed to issue a Writ of Mandamus directing the 1st respondent authority to initiate arbitration proceedings on the claim petition dated 24.03.2023 filed by the petitioner for fixing higher compensation for the petitioner.

2. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and the learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the official respondents.
3. Since there is no adverse order passed against the private respondents/R3, notice to the private respondent is dispensed with.
4.
It is submitted by the learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the official respondents that the Arbitrator/District Collector, Dharmapuri District has passed the award on 08.11.2023 itself.
Hence the relief sought for by the writ petitioner has become infructuous.
H o w e v e r , t h e p e t i t i o n e r i s a t l i b e r t y t o w o r k o u t h i s r e m e d y i n t h e m a n n e r https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.Nos.538 & 543 of 2024 known to law.

5. The Writ Petition has been filed to issue a Writ of Mandamus directing the first respondent authority to initiate arbitration proceedings on the claim petition dated 24.03.2023 filed by the petitioner for fixing higher compensation for the petitioner.

6. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and the learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondents.
7.

It is submitted by the learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondents that the Arbitrator/District Collector, Dharmapuri District has passed the award by following the seniority list.
Since the petitioner's claim has not yet been reached, the same is pending on the file of the first respondent.

Hence the Arbitrator/first respondent is directed to consider the petitioner's representation dated 24.03.2023 and after issuing notice and granting opportunity of hearing to the petitioner, https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.Nos.538 & 543 of 2024 pass orders on merits and in accordance with law and also as per seniority without further delay.
8.
With the abovesaid directions, the Writ Petitions are disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
